affiliations.date_precision: A May 1944 OSS interview identifies this as Reboa's civilian occupation, states that he entered the Army through OSS in August 1943, and notes that he was in an internment camp when recruited. Exact employment dates and a shipping company are not named.
affiliations.research_notes: Published as the best-supported last civilian affiliation, not as the immediate pre-OSS status. The report places an internment camp between merchant service and OSS recruitment.

claims.claim_text: An authoritative National Park Service history supports a high-confidence identification of indexed Louis M Ream as the OSS deputy director for administrative services.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Louis M. Ream, deputy director, administrative services
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The NPS history cites two January 1945 Ream memoranda and identifies his OSS office, matching the index's deputy-director notation.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match based on the exact name, distinctive senior role, and direct archival citations to his OSS memoranda.
claims.temporal_assessment: The source establishes Ream's wartime OSS role but does not identify his pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: A Louis Marshall Ream banking and Princeton namesake was reviewed but not linked to the OSS official and is not used as employment evidence.

claims.claim_text: Direct OSS interview evidence and official Army bulk data confirm the identity of indexed Corporal Constantino Reboa.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Cpl. Constantino Reboa... inducted through OSS
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index, Army bulk row, and 1944 OSS interview agree on his uncommon name and protected identifier; the interview also matches his rank.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed identity from three official records with exact-name, rank, and nonshared protected-identifier agreement.
claims.temporal_assessment: The OSS interview states that Reboa entered the Army through OSS in August 1943 after recruitment by Commander Breed and Lieutenant Hollingshead.
claims.match_notes: The full protected identifier is retained privately and excluded from public assets and excerpts.

claims.claim_text: The Italian Merchant Marine is the best-supported last civilian affiliation before Constantino Reboa's wartime internment and August 1943 induction through OSS.
claims.evidence_excerpt: was radio officer in the Italian Merchant Marine
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A direct OSS interview identifies Reboa's civilian role, notes his last ship, and states that he was recruited from an internment camp before Army induction through OSS.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed identity from the exact uncommon name, matching rank, and nonshared protected identifier across the index, Army data, and OSS interview.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as pre-Army civilian work. It is not labeled immediate pre-OSS because the interview places an internment camp between that work and recruitment.
claims.match_notes: The evidence supports the merchant-marine institution and occupation but does not name a shipping company or vessel.
